source: SIGLO database (LXCat, Chen ref 22): sum of the 3P2+3P1+1P1 levels — the 4s manifold (Ne*). Previously only the first level of each manifold was used, discarding ~half the 96%-bath excitation sink (EEDF inelastic wall + Ne* stepwise pool).
comment: NE 3P2 excitation. SIGLO dataset (Chen 2025, ref 22); re-sourced from crossbrowser lxcat_siglo.json, source id SIGLO__Ne__Excitation__25. Representative level: Ne 3P2 taken as the lumped Ne* metastable (arf.toml R1). Cross section stored in m^2 by SIGLO (converted to cm^2 for the CSV column).
